title: 1816 Prairie's bays rise into crowned mansards under iron cresting
items: Charles M. Henderson's house at 1816 Prairie Avenue (1904) now matches more of its photograph: both canted bays are carried up through the cornice into mansards of their own, the corner's a raised crown standing over the main roof, the south flank's lower, each ringed with iron cresting.
Iron cresting runs along the main roof's street curb, the three dormers are square-headed under pediments, and the front fence is cast-iron scrollwork instead of plain spears.
Still to come, and listed on the house's match record: the dormers in the two crowns, the carved window hoods, the balcony's taller railing with the door onto it, and the brick's dark tone.
